## Start pi from comments only

To ignore new issues and pull requests, remove the `issues` and `pull_request` events:

```yaml
on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  pull_request_review_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  pi-response:
    if: contains(github.event.comment.body, '@pi')
```
